column1: # The reads of "the player" in the world's context of an instance (stage 1.3 of the second multiplayer design: the
# resolver Players_ResolveAt of src/game/World/Players.c): the C function that reads it (Players_Any, Players_Script
# and the scripts' accessors Mode_Usr*, the money and the alarm of the context, Players_ActingAt, Players_LevelRaise)
# or Module.variable for a module variable tagged PLAYER (or PARTY outside coop), tag, why. Tags: NEAREST (the player
# nearest to the entity that runs: an entity's update, a logic's think of an entity; a wanted one first; as ANY when
# nothing runs), ANY (some player, the next one each frame: code that polls every frame sees all in turn), PARTY
# (coop: the party's acting member, its mission's; outside coop as NEAREST), WORLD (no player: the world's own money,
# alarm and module variables, no entity). A site without a row is counted by the audit as player.world.norule and
